content.short: UXUY is a multi-chain trading platform and wallet that enables native asset swaps via the unique Multi-chain Pipe.
content.description: UXUY is a leading decentralized multi-chain trading protocol and self-custodial wallet, incubated by Binance Labs and designed to solve the complexity of cross-chain asset management. The platform features the proprietary "Multi-chain Pipe" protocol, which enables near-instant swaps using native assets across various networks—including Ethereum, BNB Chain, and TON—without the security risks of wrapped tokens. UXUY also features a unique "GasLess" protocol, allowing participants to execute trades without holding native gas tokens on every network, providing a seamless gateway to DeFi.
content.meta: UXUY offers high-speed multi-chain trading and a GasLess wallet experience. Discover UXUY and other DeFi Tools on the Lancers Web3 Explorer site.
